title: Polyamide reverse osmosis membranes modified with graphene oxide for enhanced chlorine attack and fouling resistance
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00727A, Paper
Ana Luiza S. Assis, Vinicius G. de Castro, Yara L. Brasil, Cláudia K. B. de Vasconcelos, Marcelo M. Viana, Caique P. M. de Oliveira, Glaura G. Silva, Mariana G. Brondi, Miriam Cristina S. Amaral, Eduardo H. M. Nunes
Polyamide reverse osmosis membranes modified with graphene oxide (GO) showed improved water permeability, salt rejection, and resistance to chlorine attack and fouling. The GO coating also enhanced long-term stability compared to pristine membranes.
